content:
name: Temporary trace synchronization

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - trace/expanded-capability-roadmap-sync
    paths:
      - engineering/.trace-sync-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  synchronize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Regenerate deterministic EOS trace projection
        run: python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write

      - name: Synchronize deterministic machine documents
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit generated projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet --exit-code; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .eos/trace-edges.tsv machine
          git commit -m "chore(eos): synchronize deterministic trace projection"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
